fusions.name: Strike From Stillness
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 28 damage, always lands as a critical hit, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Needle
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Throws a chilled needle that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Stock Still
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Basking Point
fusions.desc: During the day, your damage rises by 10%.
